observation.p:
Known accessibility issues:
Before the Activecode text entry area there is an empty textbox that is a tab stop for screen readers. This is a known issue with the CodeMirror 5 that renders the text entry area.
Line highlights and locked regions are not announced to screen readers. This is a known issue with the CodeMirror 5 that renders the text entry area.
Optional Codelens program traces have accessibility issues with screen readers. See for details.
